areas.t: Monday, a trough of low pressure aloft will aid atmospheric mixing over the Bayou State. In addition, moderate northeasterly winds will disperse pollutants and transport a clean air mass across Louisiana as a surface low-pressure system passes south of the state. Therefore, AQI levels will be Good.
